blurb: Rock' N' Soul at GTS Theatre combines the electrifying energy of rock ‘n’ roll with the soulful magic of classic hits from the ’50s to the ’70s. This live show features talented performers paying tribute to legends like Chuck Berry, Little Richard, Chairman of the Board, Elvis Presley, The Ronettes, Aretha Franklin, and more, ensuring a night filled with iconic anthems and timeless classics. Perfect for all ages, this high-energy performance invites you to sing along and relive the best eras of music. Don’t miss this unforgettable experience that has audiences raving.
